text:
elaine_cs: Quick digest from today's onboarding calls — spotted 5 recurring asks across new accounts. Two of them are cited as renewal blockers, so flagging for product triage.

elaine_cs: Raw bullets (short):
- HelixHealth: needs per-route cost breakdown by internal team; finance says renewal contingent on clarity.
- BrightLane: embeddings staleness alerts (customer reports incorrect search results). High trust impact.
- Nebula: bulk dataset upload to portal (hours spent manually ingesting). Friction for power users.
- Nimbus: role-based dashboard filters (security/visibility ask).
- ParkCo: keyboard shortcuts & faster console flows (UX polish).

mike_pm: Thanks Elaine. Can you rank by renewal risk + suggested effort so we can slot into Q2 planning? :eyes:

elaine_cs: Short rank (risk / effort):
```
account,ask,renewal_risk,severity,quick_effort
HelixHealth,per-route-cost,high,blocking,medium
BrightLane,embed-staleness-alerts,high,data-loss,high
Nebula,portal-bulk-upload,medium,friction,high
Nimbus,role-based-views,medium,security,medium
ParkCo,console-shortcuts,low,ux,low
```

jordan_prod: Good summary. @anand_ce can you do a quick feasibility read on BrightLane and HelixHealth? Those are our highest risk.

anand_ce: BrightLane alerting — surface-level design looks like: background job to compute drift + small alerting pipeline + UI hooks. Backend + infra work, plus analytics. Rough estimate: ~3 sprints for a minimal MVP (backend + UI flag). HelixHealth cost breakdown: might be resolved by adding tokenization of per-route billing + export UI; estimate 2 sprints.

natalie_se: From enablement perspective, if we can ship a toggle or CSV export for HelixHealth, I can craft a short playbook and email template for the account within 2 days. For BrightLane, we'll need screenshots and a rollout checklist.

samira_cs: Suggest we tag each card in CS tracker with {renewal-risk:high|med|low} and attach the onboarding transcript snippet. I'll add the five items to the tracker and assign owners.

mike_pm: Proposal: prioritize BrightLane & HelixHealth for Q2 quick wins. Nebula as Q2-Q3 project if engineering capacity allows. ParkCo low effort, schedule for a mid-Q2 polish sprint. Agree? :thumbsup:

rt-sync-bot: Meeting created: Product triage sync — 2025-06-12 10:00 PT (created by @mike_pm)

elaine_cs: I'll update the shared sheet with owners + timestamps and ping #product-ops when done. Thanks all — will post the transcript snippets in the tracker. :raised_hands:
